android.desc:
Peer Fitness is a step counter and pedometer built around one habit: walking every day. Set a daily step goal, let your phone count your steps, and keep a streak going with friends.

HOW IT WORKS
• Your steps are counted automatically by your phone's step sensor or Health Connect.
• Choose a daily step goal and how many days a week you plan to walk. The other days become rest days, so one quiet day does not end your streak.
• Each day you reach your goal adds to your streak.
• See your week and month at a glance, with every day marked as goal met or missed.

WALK WITH FRIENDS
• Add a friend with a six-character invite code or a link.
• See each friend's steps today, their streak and how close they are to their goal.
• Send a nudge to a friend who has not walked yet, or a bolt to one who has.
• See in the evening when a friend's streak is at risk, and nudge them to save it.
• Open a friend's page to see their week, their month and their personal records.

LEAGUES AND ACHIEVEMENTS
• Every year is a League, from Bronze to Diamond.
• Earn points by reaching your goal, walking on the same days as your friends and walking after a nudge. Points reward consistency, so a smaller step goal moves up just as fast as a bigger one.
• Mark milestones at 7, 30 and 100 days in a row.
• Unlock achievements for your step totals and your longest streak.

STEPS, CALORIES AND DISTANCE
• Today's steps, calories burned and walking distance on one screen.
• Calories and distance come from Health Connect when it has them, or are estimated from your steps.
• The step counter keeps working in the background, so your total is current when you open the app.
• Set a daily reminder for the time that suits you.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Only friends you connect with can see your activity.
• Calories and distance stay on your phone.
• No ads, and you can delete your account at any time from the app.

PLANS
New subscribers get a 14-day trial of the monthly or yearly plan. You can also buy Lifetime access with a single payment. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel in Google Play.

DISCLAIMER
Peer Fitness is a step counter and walking tracker for everyday activity. It is not a medical device and does not give medical advice.
